notes: Steam and other launcher shortcuts are now added as the game rather than as the shortcut file. A .url on the desktop is only a few lines of text naming a game, so adding one used to store a path that lived in one Windows account and on one computer's disk. Browse and dragging a shortcut on now store the link inside it - steam://rungameid/3199170 - which is not a file at all, so it works in every account, on every machine, and keeps working when Steam rewrites its shortcuts or somebody tidies a desktop. Epic, GOG and Ubisoft shortcuts work the same way. Windows .lnk shortcuts are unchanged and still stored as a path.
